fixture_results.observation: Browser execution and rendered evidence were bound to explicit Chromium-compatible/Chromium contexts, exact source or plan identities, and observed artifacts; both evidence sets withheld any claim that the result represented other browser engines or universal browser compatibility.
non_claims: No Firefox, WebKit/Safari, broad browser-version matrix, physical mobile browser, or universal standards-conformance claim.

fixture_results.observation: Synthetic Tab/activation and automated runtime input were retained as browser-synthetic/test evidence. Human PLAYTESTED and physical keyboard/gamepad evidence were explicitly withheld rather than inferred from successful event execution.
non_claims: Synthetic DOM/browser events are not trusted human input, physical-device timing, fresh-player behavior, or accessibility acceptance.

executor_conditions: AXM browser/runtime evidence using exact Git/source identities, caller-selected Chromium-compatible execution, fresh profiles where stated, browser-synthetic events, CDP/runtime/DOM observations and actual Chromium rendering where stated.
non_claims: Not a complete reconstruction of browser-engine development or browser-engine internals.
Not cross-browser certification or standards-suite conformance.
Not human/physical-input, screen-reader, mobile-hardware or subjective UX evidence.
No frontend, accessibility, graphics, QA, product or institutional acceptance authority is granted by this TEST scope.
remaining_unknowns: Role-only versus Professional-Body controlled baseline has not yet been run.
A second intelligence executing the same Browser / Web Runtime body has not yet been compared.
Firefox/WebKit/browser-version variation, mobile browser/runtime behavior and low-level browser-engine implementation remain untested.
rollback_or_repair: If exact source identity, observed browser facts, or fixture interpretation is disproven or shown too broad, explicitly downgrade/remove this scoped TEST record while preserving the experimental body and evidence history.
